gloss: forest road; logging road; woodland path
notes:
Refers to roads through forests, originally built for forestry management and timber transport. In modern usage, also associated with hiking, trail running, and mountain biking. Many {林道|りんどう} in Japan are maintained by the Forestry Agency and are popular for outdoor recreation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {林道|りんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along a forest road
- {林道|りんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run/drive along a forest road
- {林道|りんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: for a forest road to collapse
- {林道|りんどう}⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧: forest road maintenance
- ⟦{未舗装|みほそう}→未舗装：17492_mihosou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{林道|りんどう}: unpaved forest road

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧: mountain path — a broader term for any path in the mountains
- ⟦{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}→遊歩道：23484_yuuhodou⟧: promenade, walking trail — a maintained path designed for leisure walking
- ⟦{農道|のうどう}→農道：20286_noudou⟧: farm road — a road through agricultural land

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {林|りん} (forest, woods) + {道|どう} (road, path).

definitions.gloss: forest road; logging road; woodland path
definitions.explanation: a road or trail through a forested area, typically unpaved and used for forestry work, hiking, or mountain biking
